mapper.sql: select order_item_id, order_id, product_id, unit_name, convert_ratio, base_quantity, quantity, coalesce(shipped_qty, 0) as shipped_qty, price, coalesce(discount_rate, 100.00) as discount_rate, coalesce(tax_rate, 0.00) as tax_rate, coalesce(tax_amount, 0.00) as tax_amount, amount, remark from sal_order_item
mapper.select: where order_id = #{orderId} order by order_item_id asc
